title: Question-Answer Schema
description: Schema for evaluation questions based on PubTator3 data

id.description: Globally unique question identifier: PMCID + zero-padded index

pmcid.description: PMCID of the content (represented in `id` of PubTator3 data)

author.description: Model or person that generated this QA item

question.description: Precisely worded question to test scientific knowledge retrieval and understanding
examples: Is the CML-C2 cell line considered radiosensitive?
How would H1395 and H23 cells respond to ATM inhibitor in terms of cytotoxic effects?

user_query.description: Colloquial, less precise rephrasing of the question resembling how a real user might ask it — may include abbreviations, typos, vague wording, or incomplete phrasing
examples: what happens if you give H1395 and H23 an ATM inhibtor

ideal.description: Ideal free-response / short-answer answer for the question
examples: H1395 and H23 cells already have loss of ATM function so exposure to ATM inhibitor would not show increased cytotoxic effects

choices.description: Multiple-choice options including the correct answer and plausible distractors

correct_choice_index.description: Zero-based index of the correct answer within the choices array

passage_indices.description: Indices of passages in PubTator3 data providing evidence for this question-answer entry

difficulty.description: Difficulty level: easy = single-fact lookup, medium = synthesis within a passage, hard = inference or cross-passage reasoning

question_type.description: Question category for stratified evaluation: factual = single-fact lookup, causal = cause-effect reasoning, comparative = contrasting entities or findings, inferential = drawing conclusions beyond stated facts, methodological = study design, techniques, or limitations, hypothetical = counterfactual or speculative scenarios, other = does not fit the above categories

editor_note.description: Free-text note from the editor/curator, e.g. to flag cross-paper overlap or justify difficulty rating. Not used at eval time.
